notes.title: Second Round of Playtest is Live! Try the New Version Now!
notes.notes:
Dear Explorers,

I’m excited to announce that the second round of Steam Playtest is now officially live!
Since the first test, we’ve made a lot of improvements based on your feedback and new development progress.

[h1]🆕 What’s New This Round?[/h1]
[list]
[*] 🧭 Tutorial levels to help guide your early gameplay
[*] 📖 Story mode (Work in Progress)
[*] 🖥️ Improved UI/UX — for example, you can now rename ships, buildings, and asteroids
[*] 🤖 Auto-mining ships to streamline your operations
[*] 💾 Save system: multiple saves + auto-save supported
[*] 🔍 New orbital scan mechanics — targets may maneuver, and now you can actively analyze intel
[*] ⚔️ Orbit combat system (experimental, still in development)
[/list]

[h1]🧪 How to Join?[/h1]
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/s7wjdRGD]Discord[/url] to request a Steam Playtest key!
We’ll be gradually inviting players to test this new build and help shape its future.

[h1]🧠 How You Can Help[/h1]
Whether you’re new or returning, your feedback is incredibly valuable:
[list]
[*] Can you complete the early gameplay smoothly?
[*] Where did you get confused, stuck, or bored?
[*] Which systems do you enjoy the most? The least?
[*] Is there anything that feels unnecessary or overwhelming?
[/list]

👉 Submit your thoughts by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/s7wjdRGD]Discord[/url], and let’s build this together!

💡 I'm still actively working on the full story mode and combat system, both of which will be expanded in future updates.
This Playtest is a crucial milestone leading toward our upcoming Early Access release — and your voice truly matters.

Thank you again to everyone who participated in the first test — welcome back!
And to new players: welcome aboard. It’s time to build something amazing in orbit.
